# Backend clients, schemas and test data
- API: `ApiClient` over Playwright `APIRequestContext`. Always pass `expectStatus`; pass a zod `schema` from `src/schemas/` for typed, validated bodies.
- PostgreSQL: `$1, $2` parameters only (never string concatenation); `one()` when exactly one row is expected; read-only envs allow SELECT/WITH only.
- Salesforce: build SOQL with the `soql` tagged template (escapes values); use `sf.waitFor` for integration-driven updates.
- Test data lives in `data/{excel,json,csv}`; read it through `TestDataProvider` with a zod schema so bad rows fail with file/row/field.
- Combine sources in a builder under `src/data/builders/` (reference: `appointment-case.builder.ts`).
- Never log secrets or whole data files. Downloads: `files.saveDownload()` then `validateFile()`.
